adapter.label: Your own HTTPS address
adapter.needs: Needs an HTTPS address that you run yourself and that forwards to this service.

conditions: the owner keeps the route and the certificate
a successful response alone does not prove the correct application or outside reach

cost.summary: Gozar charges nothing; your own domain, hosting and certificate cost whatever you pay for them.

disclosure.text: Validate an existing owner-managed HTTPS origin against this instance. The address, route and certificate stay under the owner’s control; Gozar creates and deletes nothing.

protocols.sse/streamableHttp: true. Backed by validation.sse (timed incremental event delivery when required) and validation.publish (exact-origin approval only after all required probes) in the wrapped recipe definition, with admission.requiredFeatures probe-assertions and client-vantage-probe.
protocols.oauthDcr: oauthDcr: the owner-managed HTTPS origin is stable by definition of this adapter, and the configured authority is preserved.
